name: Vesperal-Gyre
description: A shell of ancient ice seals the world, cracked into plates the size of nations and refrozen in place. Pressure ridges stack in turquoise ramparts, gleaming under a stingy sun near ancient meteor crater.
The air carries cold salt and iodine, and sound behaves strangely: footsteps crack loud, then die without echo. At night the temperature drops fast enough to hear the rock tick as it contracts.
Surveyors date monolithic structures of unknown origin to before the region's last cataclysm, which should be impossible. The structures are unweathered, as if time skipped this place.
The charts mark this world in cautious amber. Those who ignore the marking tend to come back rich, changed, or not at all.
